title: Questions
subtitle: Three ways to ask: intonation (Tu viens?), est-ce que (Est-ce que tu viens?), inversion (Viens-tu?). The last is literary and formal.
objectives: Apply the concepts in reading and writing.

sections.heading: Main content
sections.body: French has three strategies for forming yes-no questions: rising intonation (casual), est-ce que + statement (neutral), and subject-verb inversion (formal/literary). The choice signals register.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you can apply the concepts without hesitation.
